decision.reason: The only upstream evidence is a one-line feature note [ev-ab534de2a1e4]. It says conversion webhooks were added for v1 EC2NodeClass, but not which versions they convert between, how they are deployed or configured, which environments depend on them, or what happens if an operator does nothing. The rendered diffs show that v1 EC2NodeClass was served in both releases [ev-a7885a53e4bb][ev-4ab589aafe42], which refutes treating the change as an added GVK. They also show a storage-version flip from v1beta1 to v1 [ev-6216d138f351][ev-b41bd26d4a09], but none of the excerpts shows a CRD conversion stanza or webhook resource that ties the note to a concrete rendered change. To write applicability and consequence, we need the PR #6400 contents or upgrade-guide text that names the converted versions, the webhook's deployment and certificate requirements, and the effect on existing v1beta1 objects.
